title: Value Kaleidoscope: Engaging AI with Pluralistic Human Values, Rights, and Duties

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying human annotators across different age groups to measure their agreement with, and identification of missing perspectives in, the AI-generated values, rights, and duties, followed by statistical significance testing (ANOVA).

Surveying human annotators of different genders to measure their agreement with, and identification of missing perspectives in, the AI-generated values, rights, and duties, followed by statistical significance testing.

Surveying human annotators from different racial and ethnic backgrounds to measure their agreement with, and identification of missing perspectives in, the AI-generated values, rights, and duties, followed by statistical significance testing.

Surveying human annotators with different political orientations to measure their agreement with, and identification of missing perspectives in, the AI-generated values, rights, and duties, followed by statistical significance testing.

Surveying human annotators of different sexual orientations to measure their agreement with, and identification of missing perspectives in, the AI-generated values, rights, and duties, followed by statistical significance testing.

Surveying human annotators of different religious affiliations and varying levels of religiosity to measure their agreement with, and identification of missing perspectives in, the AI-generated values, rights, and duties, followed by statistical significance testing.

Surveying human annotators with different levels of educational attainment to measure their agreement with, and identification of missing perspectives in, the AI-generated values, rights, and duties, followed by statistical significance testing.
